definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-qrati jew mal-amministrazzjoni tal-ġustizzja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qorti ħarġet deċiżjoni ġudizzjali wara ġimgħa ta' smigħ.
usage_examples.en: The court issued a judicial decision after a week of hearings.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sistema ġudizzjali trid tkun indipendenti u ġusta.
usage_examples.en: The judicial system must be independent and fair.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-qrati jew mal-ġustizzja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-każ ġie deċiż ġudizzjalment wara ħames xhur.
usage_examples.en: The case was decided judicially after five months.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħatja ġew ipproċessati ġudizzjalment b'mod korrett.
usage_examples.en: The guilty were processed judicially in the correct manner.

definitions.text_mt: Relatat mal-qrati, il-liġi jew l-amministrazzjoni tal-ġustizzja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-poter ġudizzjarju huwa separat mill-poter eżekuttiv u leġiżlattiv.
usage_examples.en: The judicial power is separate from the executive and legislative powers.

usage_examples.mt: Il-proċess ġudizzjarju jista' jdum ħafna żmien.
usage_examples.en: The judicial process can take a very long time.

definitions.text_mt: Ħafna żmien; perjodu twil ħafna.

usage_examples.mt: Ma rajniehx minn ġudizzju sħiħ.
usage_examples.en: We have not seen him for a very long time.

usage_examples.mt: Iltqajna ma' xulxin wara ġudizzju ta' snin.
usage_examples.en: We met each other after a very long time of years.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ħila li tagħmel deċiżjonijiet sensibbli; il-kapaċità li tiġġudika b'mod korrett.
Fehma jew opinjoni dwar xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Inti għandek ġudizzju tajjeb dwar in-nies.
usage_examples.en: You have good judgment about people.

usage_examples.mt: Skont il-ġudizzju tiegħi, din hija l-aħjar għażla.
usage_examples.en: In my judgment, this is the best choice.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġudizzji tan-nies dwar il-politika huma differenti ħafna.
usage_examples.en: People's opinions about politics are very different.

definitions.text_mt: Li juri ġudizzju tajjeb; prudenti u għaqli fid-deċiżjonijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa għamel deċiżjoni ġudizzjuża meta ma xtrax dar għalja.
usage_examples.en: He made a judicious decision when he did not buy an expensive house.

usage_examples.mt: Investitur ġudizzjuż jaf meta jbigħ l-azzjonijiet.
usage_examples.en: A judicious investor knows when to sell shares.

definitions.text_mt: L-organu fil-ġisem tal-mara fejn jikber it-tarbija waqt it-tqala.

usage_examples.mt: It-tarbija kienet qed tiċċaqlaq fil-ġuf ta' ommha.
usage_examples.en: The baby was moving in its mother's womb.

usage_examples.mt: L-ultrasound wera li kollox kien tajjeb fil-ġuf.
usage_examples.en: The ultrasound showed that everything was fine in the uterus.

definitions.text_mt: Mużiċist jew poeta vjaġġatur li kien idur minn post għall-ieħor biex jiddeverti n-nies.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġuklar kien idur ir-raħal bil-kitarra tiegħu jdejjaq in-nies.
usage_examples.en: The minstrel used to go around the village with his guitar entertaining people.

usage_examples.mt: Fi żmien il-medju evu, iġ-ġuklari kienu popolari mal-kortej.
usage_examples.en: In medieval times, the troubadours were popular with the courts.

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġuklar': mużiċist jew poeta vjaġġatur.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġukulier kien figura magħrufa fil-kultura Medjevali.
usage_examples.en: The jongleur was a well-known figure in medieval culture.

usage_examples.mt: L-istejjer taġ-ġukulieri kienu jiddevertu lin-nies fil-festi.
usage_examples.en: The stories of the jongleurs used to entertain people at festivals.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta tal-familja Fabaceae, użata bħala għalf għall-annimali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bdiewa jkabbru l-ġulbiena biex jitimgħu l-bhejjem.
usage_examples.en: Farmers grow vetch to feed the livestock.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġulbiena tikber sew fl-artijiet niexfa u fil-ġebla tal-ġir.
usage_examples.en: Vetch grows well in dry lands and in limestone.

definitions.text_mt: Xarba ħelwa magħmula minn zokkor u ilma, kultant b'togħma tal-frott jew tal-ħxejjex.
Kwalunkwe ħaġa li hija ħelwa żejjed.

usage_examples.mt: It-tifel xorob il-ġulepp kollu f'daqqa u marda.
usage_examples.en: The boy drank all the julep at once and got sick.

usage_examples.mt: Dan id-deżerta huwa ġulepp wisq għall-gosti tiegħi.
usage_examples.en: This dessert is far too sweet for my taste.

definitions.text_mt: Żerriegħa żgħira b'togħma karatteristika, użata fuq il-ħobż u f'ċertu ikel ieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejt ftit ġulġlien fuq il-ħobż qabel ħamartu.
usage_examples.en: I put some sesame on the bread before baking it.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żejt tal-ġulġlien jintuża ħafna fil-kċina Asjatika.
usage_examples.en: Sesame oil is widely used in Asian cuisine.

definitions.text_mt: Siġra żgħira tal-palm, b'weraq f'forma ta' fann, li tikber madwar il-Mediterran.
Għodda tad-dar magħmula minn xkupilji, użata għat-tindif tal-art.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġummar jikber sew fl-artijiet tal-ġebla tal-ġir ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: The European fan palm grows well in Malta's limestone areas.

usage_examples.mt: Ġabret il-weraq niexfa b'ġummar il-qadim.
usage_examples.en: She gathered the dry leaves with the old broom.

definitions.text_mt: Żejjen magħmul minn ħjut maqtugħin flimkien, imdendel minn arzella, libsa jew purtiera.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġummiena maqfula mal-borża tagħti dehra eleganti.
usage_examples.en: The tassel attached to the bag gives an elegant look.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġmiemen tal-purtieri kienu miksija bid-deheb.
usage_examples.en: The curtain tassels were covered with gold.

definitions.text_mt: Qoffa jew kontenitur użat għat-tgħammir jew għat-trobbija tal-annimali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa t-tiġieġ fil-ġuna biex ibid.
usage_examples.en: The farmer put the hen in the breeding basket to lay eggs.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġwieni kienu jintużaw biex iżommu l-għasafar.
usage_examples.en: The breeding baskets were used to keep birds.

definitions.text_mt: Sinonimu ta' 'Lulju': is-seba' xahar tas-sena, b'wieħed u tletin jum.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġunjett kien ix-xahar favorit tiegħu għall-ħsad.
usage_examples.en: July was his favourite month for the harvest.

usage_examples.mt: Fi żmien il-ġunjett, il-bdiewa kienu jaħsdu l-qamħ.
usage_examples.en: In July, the farmers used to harvest the wheat.

definitions.text_mt: Is-sitt xahar tas-sena, b'30 jum, li jiġi bejn Mejju u Lulju.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġunju huwa xahar sabiħ ħafna f'Malta, b'jiem twal u sħan.
usage_examples.en: June is a very beautiful month in Malta, with long, hot days.

usage_examples.mt: Fi tmiem il-ġunju, l-iskejjel jagħlqu għas-sajf.
usage_examples.en: At the end of June, schools close for the summer.

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġulġlien': żerriegħa żgħira b'togħma karatteristika, użata fuq il-ħobż.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġunġlien jintuża ħafna fil-ħobż Malti.
usage_examples.en: Sesame is widely used in Maltese bread.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħobż biġ-ġunġlien huwa wieħed mill-aktar popolari fil-gżejjer.
usage_examples.en: Sesame bread is one of the most popular in the islands.

definitions.text_mt: Insett li jaqbeż, ta' kulur aħdar jew kannella, li jinstab fil-għelieqi u l-btieħi.
Insett tal-istess tip li jivvjaġġa fi swarms u jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-uċuħ tar-raba'.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġuradi kienu qed jaqbżu fil-ġnien kollu.
usage_examples.en: The grasshoppers were jumping all over the garden.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġurad jista' jagħmel ħsara kbira lill-uċuħ tar-raba'.
usage_examples.en: The locust can cause great damage to crops.

definitions.text_mt: Wegħda solenni, spiss b'sejħa lil Alla, li tgħid il-verità jew li twettaq xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ta l-ġurament fil-qorti qabel xehed.
usage_examples.en: He took the oath in court before testifying.

usage_examples.mt: Il-president għamel il-ġurament tal-kariga quddiem il-poplu.
usage_examples.en: The president took the oath of office before the people.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li taqdi bħala membru ta' ġuri f'qorti.
Sinonimu ta' 'ġurad': insett li jaqbeż li jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-għelieqi.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġurati ntgħażlu mill-lista taċ-ċittadini.
usage_examples.en: The jurors were chosen from the list of citizens.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġurat qabeż mill-ħaxix għoli.
usage_examples.en: The grasshopper jumped from the tall grass.

definitions.text_mt: Annimal żgħir gerriema, b'widnejn tondi u denb twil, li spiss jinstab fid-djar u fl-għelieqi.
Gerriema akbar mill-ġurdien komuni, li jgħix fil-kampanja u fil-bliet.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġurdien daħal fit-toqba malajr meta ra l-qattus.
usage_examples.en: The mouse went into its hole quickly when it saw the cat.

usage_examples.mt: Iġ-ġrieden fir-raba' jieklu l-ħbub u jistgħu jagħmlu ħsara.
usage_examples.en: The rats in the countryside eat the grain and can cause damage.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu kulur bejn l-abjad u l-iswed; griż. (Użat fid-djalett ta' Munxar, Għawdex.)

usage_examples.mt: Il-qattus ġurdni ta' nannuti kien jorqod fuq is-sufan.
usage_examples.en: My grandmother's grey cat used to sleep on the sofa.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħitan ġurdnin tad-dar taw sensazzjoni antika lill-kamra.
usage_examples.en: The grey walls of the house gave an antique feeling to the room.

definitions.text_mt: Pubblikazzjoni ta' aħbarijiet maħruġa kuljum, li jkun fiha stejjer dwar avvenimenti kurrenti.

usage_examples.mt: Kull filgħodu huwa jixtri l-ġurnal mill-ħanut tal-kantuniera.
usage_examples.en: Every morning he buys the newspaper from the corner shop.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġurnali llum qed jitkellmu dwar l-aħħar skandlu politiku.
usage_examples.en: The newspapers today are talking about the latest political scandal.

definitions.text_en: day (period when a person is awake and experiences things)
definitions.text_mt: Il-perjodu ta' żmien meta persuna tkun imqajma u attiva.
Perjodu ta' erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa.
Il-ħin bejn it-tlugħ u l-inżul ix-xemx; in-nhar.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet ġurnata sabiħa u xemxija għall-bajja.
usage_examples.en: It was a beautiful and sunny day for the beach.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġranet tal-ġimgħa huma sebgħa: it-Tnejn sal-Ħadd.
usage_examples.en: The days of the week are seven: Monday to Sunday.

usage_examples.mt: Matul il-ġurnata, it-temperatura telgħet għal tletin grad.
usage_examples.en: During the day, the temperature rose to thirty degrees.
